HANDWRITTEN STYLE MEETING NOTES - TRANSCRIBED
Matter: PSL-2026-0142
Participants: Harvey Specter; Rachel Zane; client representative from Ridge Harbor Capital LLC
Date: May 4, 2026

Notes:
- Client wants a short memo before deciding whether to delay closing.
- Rachel flagged the roof access notation as [unclear] because it may be tied to the utility easement.
- Harvey asked team to confirm whether notice was actually delivered by overnight courier and email.
- Do not state seller is in breach unless supported by the agreement and notice packet.
- Add a risk section in future drafts if exceptions or unclear source text appear.

SYNTHETIC TITLE REVIEW ADDENDUM
Matter No: PSL-2026-0142
Date: May 6, 2026
Parties: Ridge Harbor Capital LLC and West 46th Street Holdings, Inc.
Addendum: The title company confirmed the utility easement recorded in Liber 4102, Page 778
remains open.
The addendum does not resolve the handwritten roof access notation. Counsel should verify the
original scan.
Notice Clause: courier and email delivery are both required before notice is effective.

Schedule B - Exceptions
1. Taxes for calendar year 2026 are not yet due and payable.
2. Utility easement recorded in Liber 4102, Page 778 affects the rear five feet of the parcel.
3. Mortgage satisfaction for prior lender appears pending; payoff letter references File No: LND-88-204.
4. [illegible] handwritten notation beside exception 7 appears to reference "roof access" but the scanned copy is unclear.

Key Clause - Closing Deliverables
Seller must deliver a payoff letter, tenant estoppel certificates, assignment of service contracts, and an owner's affidavit before closing.

Key Clause - Notice
All notices must be sent by overnight courier and email to the parties listed on the signature page. Notice is effective on confirmed delivery.

NOTICE OF DEFAULT AND RIGHT TO CURE

Date: May 1, 2026
From: Pearson Specter Litt, counsel for Ridge Harbor Capital LLC
To: West 46th Street Holdings, Inc.
Matter No: PSL-2026-0142

The buyer asserts that the seller has not delivered the mortgage satisfaction and tenant estoppel certificates required by the closing deliverables clause.

The seller has ten (10) business days after confirmed delivery of this notice to cure the default before the buyer may pursue remedies stated in the purchase agreement.

OCR note: stamp at bottom is smudged; courier tracking number appears as 1Z-9A7-[?]-4021.

PEARSON SPECTER LITT - TITLE REVIEW PACKET
Matter No: PSL-2026-0142
Client: Ridge Harbor Capital LLC
Seller: West 46th Street Holdings, Inc.
Buyer: Ridge Harbor Capital LLC
Property: 1188 West 46th Street, New York, NY

Title Commitment dated April 24, 2026
Closing target: May 20, 2026
Purchase price: $18,400,000.00

Schedule B - Exceptions
1. Taxes for calendar year 2026 are not yet due and payable.
2. Utility easement recorded in Liber 4102, Page 778 affects the rear five feet of the parcel.
3. Mortgage satisfaction for prior lender appears pending; payoff letter references File No: LND-88-204.
4. [illegible] handwritten notation beside exception 7 appears to reference "roof access" but the scanned copy is unclear.
